title: The Rail Bridge
summary: On Day thirteen, Sam and the others cross the rainy city after a stolen dog.

beats.text: Marek's torch bobbed toward the harbour, through the rain. He had my dog.
"He will learn the key is wrong at the pier," said Hale. "Biscuit will pay."
beats.speaker: hale

beats.text: Mrs. Okafor packed our last can and a rattling tin. "Noise is a tool."
Leo knew a shortcut through the supermarket. Two of them drifted between shelves.
She rolled the tin down aisle three. The shuffling followed it away.
We crossed the rail bridge inside a dead train. Rain hid every step.
Dara froze. A shape sat in the last seat, head bowed, still.
Pier Four rose out of the fog. The tug's lamp was lit.
Marek held Biscuit up like a lantern and turned the roof key. Nothing.
He cupped his hands. "Sam!" Loud enough to wake the whole pier.
